It took Base 6 months to reach a TVL of $1B+, and another 6 months to hit a TVL of $2B+.

Robinhood Chain hit a TVL of $1B+ in just 3 months, and it did it in the heart of the bear market.

It's still early.

And as far as the narrative that it's dead?

People were saying the same thing in early August right before a massive move higher.

We're in the same spot now, but there's more capital, so the next leg higher will be more violent when it happens.

Robinhood has access to more new retail capital and a direct integration for its chain unlike any new L1/L2 that we've seen.

It feels obvious that it'll fill the TVL gap with a bit more time... more capital inflow = more momentum.

If BASE & SOL could have multiple coins hit valutions of multiple billions last cycle, I see no reason why Robinhood Chain won't do the same now.

That's why I truly believe coins like $HMM that have survived this on chain selloff have the potential to hit billions, and have incredible confidence just stacking and being patient.

Higher is a matter of when, not if.

Be more bullish.
